name: Política Nacional de Cibersegurança (Decreto nº 11.856/2023)
description: Política Nacional de Cibersegurança (PNCiber, Decreto nº 11.856/2023). Brazil's national cybersecurity strategy and policy framework issued by the Presidency of the Republic / Institutional Security Cabinet (GSI/PR), comprising the first E-Ciber (2020-2023, Decreto nº 10.222/2020), the National Cybersecurity Policy PNCiber (Decreto nº 11.856/2023), and the second E-Ciber (2025-2028, Decreto nº 12.573/2025).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br).
